Computer Networks Unit 1 Notes:
The Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model defines seven layers for network communication:
1. Physical Layer: Transmits raw bit streams over physical medium.
2. Data Link Layer: Node-to-node data transfer and framing.
3. Network Layer: Packet routing and logical IP addressing.
4. Transport Layer: End-to-end communication and TCP reliability.
5. Session Layer: Manages sessions between applications.
6. Presentation Layer: Data translation, compression, and encryption.
7. Application Layer: End-user network interfaces and HTTP protocols.
COMPUTER NETWORKS

Computer 
Networking: A Top 
Down Approach

more bandwidth available)
